entries.category_description: Provision, construction, renovation and alteration of housing, as part of a social policy
entries.code_description: Construction works in public entertainment, education, hospital, institutional care or religious buildings
entries.comment:
Services dependent on procurement contracts relating to the construction of 1ry&2ry urbanization works metropolitan tramway transport lines and other fixed  lines;production plants and heat-energy and electricity distribution networks from solar-photovoltaic-wind sources;purification plants to be connected to sewer networks including intermunicipal ones and to the relative adduction manifolds;school buildings barracks hospital nursing home orphanages.
The CPA code 41.00.48 is also included.
